11.text: At the time of the first conquest, walrus were so numerous, that one

12.text: party of public-service men presented to the Treasury fifty puds¹ of walrus-

13.text: ivory. The report of that party says, “We found on the spit near the mouth

14.text: of the Anadyr River ivory of dead walrus. We gathered that ivory, put away

15.text: for the Czar three puds of it,² and the remainder we divided among our-

16.text: selves. Altogether, we gathered for the Czar a great profit, — fifty puds

17.text: of walrus-ivory, the first pud three tusks, the second pud four tusks, etc.”

18.text: So the tusks of the first pud each weighed twelve pounds Avoirdupois. The

19.text: same report states, “In the 162d year (1654), when we were on that spit

20.text: for the purpose of gathering those walrus-tusks, close to that spit lived also

21.text: some Koryak people, who slunk along with the intention of murder. Then

22.text: I, Yuriy, and my comrades, and the service-men Semen Deshnev and com-

23.text: rades, went against those men, and found their hamlet, fourteen large houses.

24.text: And their place was fortified; but with the aid of God we took that fort,

25.text: and also women and children. The best men, however, escaped, and took

26.text: with them their wives and children. Because they were quite numerous, each

27.text: house had ten families and more. We, on the contrary, were not many, —

29.text: The Koryak in question could have been no other people than the Keˊrek

30.text: from Cape Navarin. Though at the present time quite wretched and rapidly

31.text: dying out, the Keˊrek, according to their own traditions, were in former times

32.text: much more numerous, had large boats, and lived on walrus. They also may

33.text: have been in the habit of going to the Anadyr spit for hunting. Nowadays

34.text: almost the whole number of the Keˊrek tribe hardly equals the population

35.text: of that single ancient village, which, according to the report, had fourteen

36.text: large houses, with ten families and more in each house.³
